errors.final_answer_failed: ⚠️ The tools ran, but the model failed while writing the final answer. What the tools did is real; ask it to continue to get the summary. Reason: {{reason}}
errors.final_answer_empty: ⚠️ The tools ran, but the model wrote no final answer. What the tools did is real; ask it to continue to get the summary.
errors.malformed_model_response: ⚠️ The model returned a malformed response (internal tool syntax). Try again or rephrase your request.
errors.task_timed_out: ⚠️ The task timed out: its worker never finished it (it may have restarted mid-task). Please send it again.
errors.llm_timeout: ⏱️ The model did not finish in time: the task needed longer than allowed (10 minutes in the cloud, 15 with the local model). Try a narrower request or a faster model for this agent.
errors.cron_sources_unread: 📭 The scheduled task did not open its sources this time, so it delivered nothing: an answer written without reading them could be made up. It will try again at its next run.

connections.name: Connections
connections.description: Apps and services your agents can drive (ready-made MCP servers)
connections.intro: Each connection says what every one of its tools does: the ones that only read run freely; the ones that change something ask for your permission when they should. After installing one, give it to an agent in Agents → Tools.
connections.unclassifiedHint: An unclassified tool is treated as if it both read outside content and acted: once the task has read something external, it waits for your approval. Tools are classified with “toolRisk” in the server's configuration.
connections.noneHere: There are no connections on this computer yet.
connections.manualHint: The connections you set up by hand in Add-ons → MCP servers are listed here but left alone: edit and remove them there.
connections.catalogError: Could not read the connections catalog (offline?). The installed ones keep working.
connections.removeConfirm: Remove the connection “{{name}}”? Agents lose its tools.
connections.replaceConfirm: You already have a server called “{{name}}” that you set up by hand. Replace it with the catalog's?
connections.modifiedConfirm: You changed the command or the classification of “{{name}}” by hand. Updating overwrites those changes (the switch and the environment variables are kept). Continue?
connections.takenWarn: You already have a server with this name, set up by hand in Add-ons. Installing the catalog's replaces it.
connections.modifiedWarn: This connection was edited by hand after it was installed. Updating it overwrites those changes (the switch and the environment variables are kept).
connections.updateHint: You have version {{from}}; the catalog has {{to}}. Updating keeps the switch and your environment variables.
connections.installedOk: “{{name}}” is installed. It connects on its own in a few seconds; give it to an agent in Agents → Tools.
connections.installedMissing: “{{name}}” is installed, but the program that starts it is missing. Open “View” to see how to install it; HydraOps retries on its own, nothing needs restarting.
connections.requires: What it needs on this computer
connections.requiresNothing: Nothing: it is a remote service.
connections.launcherMissing: is not installed. Install it with:
connections.pinnedHint: The program's version is pinned: it does not change until you update the connection.

clsHint.acts: asks for permission if the task has already read outside content
clsHint.both: brings in third-party content and also acts: asks for permission if the task has already read outside content
